idea-plugin.name: Class Diagrams for OpenIDE
idea-plugin.description: Interactive UML class diagrams for selected Java classes and packages. Fields, methods, inheritance, interfaces, associations and dependencies. Automatic layout, obstacle-aware arrows, editable connection points and waypoints. Dragging, zoom, source navigation, SVG, PNG and PlantUML export. Runs locally without Graphviz or web services.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.2.0: Diagram positions, hidden classes, manual arrow routes, filters, theme and viewport persist in project settings and restore after reopening the diagram. 1.1.0: Orthogonal arrows automatically choose attachment sides and avoid class cards. Drag an arrow to add a waypoint; move endpoint handles to change attachment points. Double-click adds a waypoint. Delete removes it. R resets the selected route. Manual routes and positions survive filters and refresh for unchanged relations.
